essentialQuestion: How can understanding leadership, coaching, and officiating help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain demonstrating cues in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of giving feedback.

Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving officiating fairly; correct it and explain why.
Connect demonstrating cues with inclusive adaptation. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Lead, coach, or officiate part of an activity and evaluate the experience using participant evidence.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.
